segments.en: Bailey, how fast is this changing? Is it minute by minute at this point with all of the news headlines?

segments.en: They put in their orders the first day, which is not normal. Normally with the NIPO, the big investors, they come in at the end.

segments.en: Well, so when we think about this deal, this is the first time we're going to see the demand side of AI.
segments.zh: 当我们看这笔交易时，这是第一次看到AI的需求侧。

segments.en: And what I mean by that is we've been reporting on Nvidia or CoreWeave and how much demand there is for compute, which is all fine and dandy, but how our company is actually implementing that.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，我们一直在报道英伟达或CoreWeave以及算力需求有多大，这都没问题，但公司实际如何落地才是关键。

segments.en: Anthropic is going to be the first test case and first opportunity for investors to invest in a pure play AI company that is trying to move the ball forward.
segments.zh: Anthropic将是第一个测试案例，也是市场参与者首次有机会配置纯AI公司，这家公司正努力推动进展。

segments.en: So when you think about Anthropic, when we talk to investors, it's an end of one company, but it's also really a must-own if you believe in the end game of AI.
segments.zh: 所以当你想到Anthropic，与市场参与者交流时，它是一家公司，但如果你相信AI的终局，它也是必须配置的。
